notes.title: [Hotfix] Update v 1.4.1
notes.content:
This patch addresses issues with the New Year event introduced in version 1.4, fixing a discovered UI bug and implementing several minor gameplay improvements.

[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The CRT effect no longer appears when the corresponding setting is disabled
[*] The introductory dialogue no longer plays during repeat visits to the same location within a single game session
[*] The end-game message now also appears after successfully completing the event
[*] End-game messages are now localized based on the selected language
[/list]

notes.title: Almost-Not-Casual New Year Event
notes.content:
[h2][b]Did you [i]seriously[/i] think no one would ask Ded Moroz [spoiler][i](the Slavic counterpart of Santa Claus, if something)[/i][/spoiler] to sort out the situation in Kitay-gorod on New Year’s Eve? Big mistake.[/b][/h2]

Hop on a sleigh and get ready to fight back with something that isn’t an empty can or bottle, for the first time in Scary Horror history! All you need to do is find the festive tree somewhere in Kitay-gorod.

May 2025 bring you joy, and bring us... many villas in Nice!

Best wishes,

Skilkihodin Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015609/06bf8c646f30909d9987123d2d75fddba1cf2051.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v 1.4 "Ded Moroz's New Year Patch"
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added support for Xbox gamepads
[*]Missing hitboxes for environment objects have been added in some locations
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the Scary Horror game window to stretch uncontrollably in certain locations when running in windowed mode
[*]Fixed a bug that caused opponent scores to display in the wrong position after returning from the pause menu
[*]The credits have been updated
[*][h3]Something hidden before can now be revealed...[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Vote for us!
notes.content:
[h3]Being [b]the best game of 2025[/b], Scary Horror still deserves the spotlight in 2024 as well! If you’ve had a blast [i](or a scare)[/i] playing, we’d love it if you voted for us as Game of the Year.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015609/bb6543f677ba60f0bf423526379131c902385d7e.png[/img]

In the meantime, we’re busy cooking up awesome new updates to make the game even better.

Thanks for sticking with us!

notes.title: [Hotfix] Update v 1.3.1
notes.content:
Unfortunately, an annoying bug slipped into the final build of Scary Horror v1.3, related to the newly added pause menu. This patch addresses this issue.

On behalf of the entire studio, we’d like to thank [b]Mizero[/b] for notifying us about this problem!

[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Health values saved upon exiting to the pause menu are no longer applied to opponents when restarting the battle
[/list]

notes.title: Almost-On-Time Halloween Event
notes.content:
[h2][b]Rumors say that somewhere in Kitay-gorod, there's a [i]very poorly[/i] hidden pumpkin that will [i]definitely[/i] not do anything bad to whoever touches it…[/b][/h2]

Unfortunately, we didn’t quite manage to release this event in time for Halloween, but we hope this little delay won’t stop you from enjoying this limited-time content, open to all the curious adventurers on repeat playthroughs!

Look around carefully — you just might spot something unusual...

Best wishes,

Skilkihodin Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015609/f63e9a3b8b442bca13d6b50996a28bea1c6109db.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v 1.3 "Lyolia's Halloween Patch"
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]The game executable has been made unpacked to address issues with false-positive detections by antivirus programs
[*]An in-game pause menu has been added [i](temporarily available only from Kitay-gorod and the final battle)[/i]
[*]Building sprites containing text now localize based on the selected language
[*]Missing Exit signs have been added to one of the locations
[*]Fixed a bug where player footsteps were audible even when sound was turned off
[*]The credits have been updated
[*][h3]Something hidden before can now be revealed...[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v 1.2 "Gena's Language Patch"
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changing the game language in the main menu now saves even if no other settings are modified afterward
[*]Some textures containing text now localize based on the selected language
[*]Text prompts during the final battle no longer stop appearing when opponents take turns too quickly
[*]The cursor no longer remains visible on the screen when launching the game
[*]Character appearance when transitioning to the final location is now smoother
[*]The positions of some objects have been adjusted
[*]The credits have been updated
[*][h3]Something hidden before can now be revealed...[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v 1.1 "Megaflex Ricarder Patch"
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes and updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]During the final battle, the player's turn is no longer skipped more than once if the "Stand" option is chosen when the fighters have equal scores
[*]The bad ending is no longer triggered by ignoring the QTE after the final battle
[*]Ambient sounds no longer start playing twice when the character is teleported to the final location
[*]Movement near bottle locations in buildings is not interrupted if the bottle has already been picked up
[*]The freeze frame from one of the videos is not displayed when exiting the school building through the door
[*]The credits have been updated
[/list]
